components.operation: Use the same direction and same function at w+delta u and w-delta u; scale their difference by d/(2 delta) and multiply by u.
components.requires: Symmetric uniform-sphere direction and paired same-function exact evaluations; the linked bound additionally requires its full Lipschitz and norm assumptions.

content.family: Symmetric two-point finite differences with a uniform Euclidean sphere direction

limitations.statement: Exact paired evaluations of the same function are required by the extracted implementation; arbitrary independent evaluation noise is not covered.

The sphere-average gradient identity in Lemma 8 is not adopted. This component has no extracted unbiasedness assertion. The Algorithm 1 T-1/T indexing issue is outside the selected single-estimate scope.

variants.cost: Exactly two function-value queries to the same function and one uniform-sphere sample per estimate. Direction generation and vector arithmetic are separately required computational operations; no runtime bound or free sampling assumption is asserted. No gradients, projection or mirror-map optimization are performed by this component.
variants.implementation_details_ref: PDF p.3 Eq.(3); p.4 Algorithm 1 estimator lines
variants.name: Single symmetric estimator, Eq.(3)
variants.output: A vector gtilde in R^d. It is not a feasible optimization solution or a regret certificate.
public_inputs: Dimension d, center w, radius delta>0, and access to the same function f at both query points
variants.query_and_update: Draw one u uniformly on S^(d-1); query y_plus=f(w+delta u) and y_minus=f(w-delta u); return gtilde=[d/(2 delta)](y_plus-y_minus)u. No optimizer update is part of this component.
variants.requirements: Both exact values f(w+delta u) and f(w-delta u) must be available. For the linked moment bound retain convexity, Euclidean G2-Lipschitzness on the domain containing all queried points, and the stated fourth moment of the chosen dual norm. Values must use the same function realization.
variants.state_and_initialization: Stateless single-estimate component. Fix f, w and delta before drawing u uniformly on S^(d-1). There is no persistent iterate or optimizer initialization in this selected component.
variants.tuning_and_stopping: Any delta>0 with legal queries; terminate after the two values and vector calculation. The component requires no horizon or step size. G2 and p_* enter the moment analysis, not the estimator formula.
